description: Release 2.3.0 export (ADR 0054). version "source" holds actual values only; version "filled" applies the stored fillings and the exporter defaults with draw-only water heating. 6.0.0 changes from 5.4.0: evidence rows take the shape constructions use, with an id, and the document holds every row it cites; loads carry status, reason, filling and evidence_id; nulls gives the meaning of every null; dwelling window ratios that depend on context are fenestration.variants.
